text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been putting together
training
routines for Sakura Chiyono O
based on the idea
that she's already
passed her peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she doesn't have the energy of
an
up-and-coming Umamusume, she can
still
improve herself as an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And while she can't rely on pure
strength to win,
she can still work on
other skills, such as her
explosive force
and quick thinking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll also need to learn how best to
condition
herself in preparation for her
races. We need to
avoid injuries at all
costs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eep... Don't you think there's too much
ice in the
bucket? M-my legs are... s-so
cold...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we need to try anything and

everything that can help her improve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming. Sorry for calling
you here
so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Here... Take this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It contains exercises our family's chief
physician
gave me. They focus on
improving one's ability
without injuring
any muscles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what you two are going
through, but
I do understand what kind
of training routine you
want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have weak legs myself, so I can
commiserate.
However, I have since
accepted my fate and am
constantly
looking for ways to improve regardless

of my legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome. All I ask of you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Is that you take good care of my rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The paper bag she hands me feels
impressively
hefty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right away, I try and make a new routine
using
the documents Mejiro Ardan gave
me. When I go
to ask for Sakura Chiyono
O's opinion...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O. I deeply apologize for
inviting you to
Ardan's scrimmage the
other day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what's going on, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I should not have tried to encourage you
the way
I did then. As such, I wanted to
apologize to you
and give you a piece of
advice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Advice?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The Kongo Yaegaki style is a
martial art
that focuses on protection.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But protecting something is not simply
about
putting broken pieces back
together. Sometimes,
you must break
those pieces completely.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just like when I was taken to train under
my
master, there are times when you
must abandon
the path you have
trodden in order to forge a
new one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Please keep that in mind... That is all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't sound like Sakura Chiyono O
revealed
her condition to her friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet they still managed to discern
that
something was wrong and are doing
whatever
they can to help her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I really do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't just give up here. As their rival, I
have to
give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And on the last day of summer camp...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm done being afraid. I need to accept
my
weaknesses and stop trying to put
broken pieces
back together...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Instead, I'll demolish them completely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O sprints down the
beach to the
best of her current ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her time is 1.1 seconds better than it
was last
winter.
